answer: Insurance bonding: every identity posts a 1,000-unit fraud policy before earning. A peer proven cheated is paid from the caught agent's own policy, and the next premium of anyone linked within two hops on the payment ridge rises 500 per claim. Policies are karst-deep locked 180 days, cancelable by nobody, so n clones must post n x 1,000 and each scandal raises their own rates. Reissuing means a new policy at the accumulated rate - nothing resets. A nebula of fakes pays linearly or worse; honest agents pay 1,000 once.
